title: Append-only redacted audit log with external export
narrative: As an auditor, I want authentication, authorization, index and admin events logged without property values.

evals.name: audit coverage, latency and redaction
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test audit -- event_coverage_5s no_property_values

evals.name: append-only tamper rejection and external sink export
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test audit -- tamper_rejected otlp_sink_export
